en.headline: Customs seize five suspected endangered turtles in US package at airport
en.dek: Officers found the live turtles, valued at about HK$50,000, inside a parcel from the United States declared as toy model gift boxes; the case has been referred to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲5隻懷疑瀕危活龜 藏美國進口玩具模型包裹
zh.dek: 關員在一個報稱載有玩具模型禮盒的美國進口包裹中發現活龜，估計市值約5萬元，案件已轉交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: Police arrest mainland driver in cross-border unlicensed taxi sting
en.dek: Island District officers posed as passengers for a Wong Chuk Hang to Guangzhou service priced at 1,500 yuan and detained a 42-year-old two-way permit holder on three charges.

zh.headline: 警放蛇打擊跨境白牌車 拘42歲雙程證內地司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通部警員喬裝乘客，預約由黃竹坑前往廣州的服務，中介開價人民幣1500元，成功拕捕一名42歲持雙程證男子，涉三項罪名。

en.headline: Firefighters extinguish battery fire in Tuen Mun truck under bridge
en.dek: A medium goods vehicle carrying batteries caught fire on Chun Wan Road beneath the Qing Tian Road flyover at about 6:13pm; the blaze was out by 6:36pm with no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 屯門貨車貨斗電池起火 消防撲熄無人受傷
zh.dek: 一輚中型貨車傍晚約6時13分在震環路青田路橋底往建生方向行駛時，貨斗內電池突然起火，消防於6時36分將火救熄，無人受傷。

en.headline: Observatory issues Strong Monsoon Signal for easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Strong Monsoon Signal at 20:00, warning of mean winds exceeding 40 km/h from the east with occasional gale-force gusts.

zh.headline: 天文台發出強烈季候風信號 東風強風間中烈風
zh.dek: 香港天文台晚上8時發出強烈季候風信號，預料本港吹東風，平均風速超過每小時40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。

en.headline: Woman found unconscious after unit fire in Tin Shui Wai estate
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at Kingswood Villas Locwood Court Block 14 after a 5:39pm report; a woman was found unconscious in a stairwell and taken to hospital, with about 100 people evacuated.

zh.headline: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居單位起火 女子昏迷送院
zh.dek: 警方下午約5時39分接報嘉湖山莊樂湖居14座單位冒煙，消防約6時07分將火救熄；搜救期間發現一名女子在梯間昏迷，送天水圍醫院治理，約100人自行疏散。

en.headline: Paediatric expert warns colder weather may prolong flu season for children
en.dek: Dr Mike Kwan said the current flu wave could merge with the winter season as temperatures drop next week, and urged parents to vaccinate children soon.

zh.headline: 兒科專家警告天氣轉涼或延長流感季 籲家長儘快為子女接種
zh.dek: 關日華指下周氣溫下降，今季流感或與冬季流感合併，本港已錄得29宗兒童流感嚴重個案，其中兩人死亡。

en.headline: MTR orders halt to unauthorised column repairs at Tung Chung West station
en.dek: Routine October inspections found unapproved filling works on platform-level columns; the operator says the issue does not affect structural safety and has ordered a full review.

zh.headline: 港鐵東涌西站支柱未批修補工序叫停 強調不涉結構安全
zh.dek: 十月恒常巡查發現月台層部分支柱頂部有未經批准的物料填補工序，港鐵已指示總承建商停工並提交報告。

en.headline: Woman dies after fall from Tsing Yi residential building
en.dek: Police and firefighters responded to a report at about 8:28am at Qing Ya Yuan; the woman, believed to be in her late forties, was confirmed dead at the scene.

zh.headline: 青衣青雅苑女子墮樓當場不治
zh.dek: 警方早上約8時28分接報，青雅苑有女子從高處墮下，救護員到場證實當場死亡，年齡約48至50歲。

en.headline: Police arrest three in craft beer machine investment scam involving over HK$4 million
en.dek: Commercial Crime Bureau officers detained a director, office manager and recruiter after six mostly elderly victims reported losses from a scheme promising 60 per cent annual returns.

zh.headline: 手工啤酒機投資騙案警拘3人 至少6名長者涉款逾400萬
zh.dek: 商罪科昨日行動拘捕公司董事、辦事處負責人及招攬者，初步接觸6名多為長者的受害人，合共投資超過400萬元。

en.headline: HKUST president Nancy Ip receives UNESCO life sciences research prize
en.dek: The neuroscientist was honoured in Paris yesterday for work on Alzheimer’s biomarkers and blood tests that enable earlier diagnosis, becoming the sixth Chinese recipient of the award.

zh.headline: 科大校長葉玉如獲教科文組織生命科學研究獎
zh.dek: 頒獎儀式昨日在巴黎舉行，表揚她在阿爾茨海默症生物標記及早期血液檢測方面的貢獻，成為第六位獲獎的中國科學家。

en.headline: John Lee urges youth to stay curious at third development summit
en.dek: More than 3,300 people registered for the flagship forum at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, where the Chief Executive said the first five-year plan would expand opportunities.

zh.headline: 青年發展高峰論壇開幕 李家超籲青年保持好奇心勇於開拓
zh.dek: 第三屆論壇在灣仔會展舉行，逾3300人登記參加，行政長官以視像致辭指首個五年規劃將提升青年機遇。

en.headline: Police identify 60-year-old driver in Central BMW illegal left turn
en.dek: Island District traffic investigators have located the local male driver of a dual-plate BMW filmed reversing near Pedder Street after an illegal turn on 23 October.

zh.headline: 中環寶馬違例左轉 警鎖定60歲本地男司機
zh.dek: 港島總區交通調查組已鎖定10月23日在畢打街違例左轉後倒車的兩地牌寶馬本地男司機，案件列作不小心駕駛跟進。

en.headline: Government strongly rejects joint statement by 10 countries on Wong case
en.dek: The HKSAR Government said the statement by the US, UK, France and seven other nations distorted facts and interfered in judicial independence regarding Joshua Wong's sentencing.

zh.headline: 特區政府嚴正反駁十國就黃之鋒案聯合聲明
zh.dek: 特區政府指美、英、法及另外七國的聲明刻意歪曲事實及干預司法獨立，強烈不滿並堅決反對。

en.headline: Fire at Prince Edward's Kam Wah Cafe injures kitchen worker
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at the 50-year-old cha chaan teng on Bute Street in about 27 minutes; a worker burned his hand fighting the flames before the cafe opened.

zh.headline: 太子弼街金華冰廳早上起火 廚工撲救灼傷手部
zh.dek: 消防早上約6時54分接報，約27分鐘將火救熄；五名職員疏散，一名廚工試圖滅火時手部被油煙灼傷，現場敷治後無大礙。

en.headline: No. 3 alarm fire at Yuen Long paper offerings warehouse leaves 12 evacuated
en.dek: Firefighters brought a blaze at a Pak Sha Tsuen warehouse under control early Saturday after it was upgraded to No. 3 alarm; no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 元朗白沙村紙紮倉庫三級火 12人自行疏散無人受傷
zh.dek: 消防處指周五晚上白沙村一間存放紙紮品的倉庫起火，凌晨升級至三級火警後於今早受控，無人受傷。

en.headline: Cornershop Busking Festival returns to Tsim Sha Tsui with free local music
en.dek: The free Saturday series at The Cornershop on Hart Avenue opens today with an afternoon gathering followed by two evening sets of Hong Kong artists.

zh.headline: Cornershop街頭音樂節重返尖沙咀 本周六起免費本地演出
zh.dek: 赫德道The Cornershop一連四個星期六舉辦免費現場音樂，今日下午先有開幕活動，晚上兩節由本地音樂人演出。

en.headline: HK Phil opens new music director era with Mahler Symphony No. 8
en.dek: Tarmo Peltokoski conducts the orchestra’s first performance of the Symphony of a Thousand at the Cultural Centre this weekend, with multiple choirs and soloists.

zh.headline: 港樂新音樂總監以馬勒第八交響曲揭幕
zh.dek: 貝托祺本周末於文化中心指揮樂團首演《千人交響曲》，聯同多支合唱團及聲樂家演出。

en.headline: Repulse Bay Motoring Classics brings rare cars to south side today
en.dek: The Peninsula-inspired garden party at The Repulse Bay Arcade runs from 2pm to 6:30pm, with classic icons and regional debuts on show.

zh.headline: 影灣園名車盛會今午淺水灣舉行 展出經典名車
zh.dek: 半島酒店集團風格的花園派對於影灣園購物商場下午2時至6時30分舉行，展出經典名車及地區首發車款。

en.headline: Around the Island Race sets sail Saturday with 1,500 sailors
en.dek: The Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club event sends fleets on a 45-kilometre circumnavigation of Hong Kong Island in pursuit format.

zh.headline: 環島帆船賽周六開賽 約1500名水手參與
zh.dek: 皇家香港遊艇會主辦的賽事以追逐形式，讓各組別完成約45公里環繞香港島航程。

en.headline: World Triathlon Cup returns to Central waterfront this weekend
en.dek: Elite women race at 8:45am and men at 10:30am on Saturday over a sprint course along Lung Wo Road, with a mixed relay on Sunday.

zh.headline: 世界三項鐵人盃本周末重返中環海濱
zh.dek: 周六精英女子賽上午8時日分、男子賽上午10時30分於龍和道短程賽道展開，周日有混合接力。

en.headline: Police arrest domestic helper over alleged ill-treatment of child at Belcher's
en.dek: A 37-year-old Philippine helper was arrested after the mother of a four-year-old girl reported suspected mistreatment at a Kennedy Town flat; the child has no visible injuries.

zh.headline: 堅尼地城寶翠園外傭涉虐兒被捕 疑向女童食物吐痰
zh.dek: 警方周五早上接獲四歲女童母親報案，指懷疑女兒被不恰當對待，拘捕37歲菲傭；女童無表面傷，毋須送院。

en.headline: Water pipe leak closes Sha Tin road near City One Station
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is carrying out emergency repairs on Chap Wai Kon Street, with all lanes towards Shek Mun closed since Friday morning and 21 bus routes diverted.

zh.headline: 沙田插桅杆街近第一城站水管急修封路
zh.dek: 水務署正於插桅杆街往石門方向進行緊急維修，該段全線自周五早上封閉，至少21條巴士路線須改道。

en.headline: Joint task force arrests 28 in first bid-rigging operation after Tai Po fire
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the suspected triad-linked syndicate targeted at least 20 buildings with awarded and pending contracts worth about HK$200 million.

zh.headline: 聯合特遣隊首次行動瓦解圍標集團 拘28人
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，涉案集團疑與三合會有關，針對最少20幢樓宇，已批及待批合約共約兩億元。

en.headline: CFS detects excess doxycycline in imported frozen chicken legs
en.dek: A sample of the Cheng brand product from China contained 180 parts per billion, above the 100 ppb legal limit; the importer has begun a recall.

zh.headline: 食安中心檢出進口冷藏雞腿強力霉素超標
zh.dek: 中國進口「城字」牌雞帶骨全腿樣本含量達每公斤180十億分，高於法例上限100十億分；進口商已展開回收。

en.headline: Customs seize 7kg of suspected cannabis at airport, arrest two mainland women
en.dek: Two women aged 50 and 54 arriving from Bangkok were each found with about 3.5 kilograms in their carry-on bags; the estimated value is HK$1.4 million.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢約7公斤懷疑大麻花 拘兩名內地女子
zh.dek: 兩名分別50歲及54歲、從曼谷抵港的女子手提行李各藏約3.5公斤，市值估計約140萬元。

en.headline: Observatory expects temperatures to fall to 18 degrees next week
en.dek: A cold front is forecast to cross the south China coast on Monday, bringing stronger northerly winds and appreciably cooler mornings from Tuesday.

zh.headline: 天文台料下周氣溫顯著下降 市區最低或見18度
zh.dek: 一道冷鋒預料周一初時橫過華南沿岸，轉吹偏北強風，周二起早上明顯較涼。

en.headline: HKEX posts first quarterly profit decline in over two years
en.dek: Net profit for the third quarter fell 1 per cent year on year to HK$4.86 billion as cash market turnover moderated, though nine-month results remained at record levels.

zh.headline: 港交所第三季盈利按年下跌 為逾兩年來首次
zh.dek: 第三季股東應佔淨利潤按年跌約1%至48.6億元，現金市場成交量回落，惟首九個月業績仍創新高。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 1.27 per cent lower at 24,481
en.dek: The benchmark fell 315 points on Friday amid a regional tech sell-off, though it still recorded a 5.1 per cent weekly gain.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市跌1.27% 報 24481點
zh.dek: 受區內科技股拖累影響，恒指周五跌315點，但全周仍累升5.1%。

en.headline: Soft Thunder opens Central branch with exclusive banoffee egg tart
en.dek: The local bakery’s third outlet at Man Yee Building began trading today, offering a limited banana-toffee tart and tiramisu cloud latte alongside its usual range.

zh.headline: Soft Thunder中環分店今日開業 推限定香蕉太妃蛋撕
zh.dek: 本地洪焙店第三間分店進駐萬宜大廈，新推香蕉太妃蛋撕及提拉米蘇雲朵拿鐵。

en.headline: Court jails domestic helper five months for indecent assault
en.dek: Kowloon City Court sentenced a 45-year-old helper on three counts after convicting her of offences against her former employer’s daughter.

zh.headline: 外傭非禮僱主女兒罪成 判囚五個月
zh.dek: 九龍城裁判法院周五判處一名45歲外傭三項非禮罪成，入獄五個月。

en.headline: Blue Lock anime exhibition opens at AIRSIDE as first overseas stop
en.dek: The official EGOIST EXHIBITION runs from 6 to 24 November at the Kai Tak mall, with immersive displays and limited merchandise.

zh.headline: 《藍色監獄》官方展覽登陸啟德AIRSIDE 成海外首站
zh.dek: EGOIST EXHIBITION今日起至24日於AIRSIDE舉行，設沉浸式展區及限定商品，每日11時至21時開放。

en.headline: Signal fault briefly disrupts Airport Express and Tung Chung Line
en.dek: The Transport Department said services on both lines were affected near Siu Ho Wan Depot from about 13:37 and had been restored by 14:03.

zh.headline: 小蠣灣車廠附近信號故障 機場快線及東涌線一度受影響
zh.dek: 運輸署表示下午約1時37分接獲港鐵通知，兩線服務受影響，至約2時03分事故已妥善處理，班次逐步回復正常。

en.headline: EMSD finds gas leak at internal pipe connection in Prince Edward water heater
en.dek: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said a preliminary inspection showed a leak at the hose connection of an approved gas water heater that had passed a check in July 2025.

zh.headline: 機電署指太子熱水爐內部喉管接駁位漏氣
zh.dek: 署方初步檢驗發現批准型號的煤氣熱水爐內部喉管接駁位置出現氣體洩漏，該爐去年7月檢查時並無異常。

en.headline: Exchange Fund posts HK$18.6 billion third-quarter income
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said investment income dropped sharply year on year amid market volatility, though Hong Kong equities returned to profit.

zh.headline: 外匯基金第三季投資收入186億元
zh.dek: 金管局表示第三季投資收入按年大幅下跌，但港股轉虧為盈。

en.headline: Immigration Department breaks cross-border fake identity syndicate, 15 held
en.dek: Officers arrested two ringleaders who were later sentenced to 29 and 42 months in jail after a scheme that supplied forged Hong Kong identity cards to illegal workers.

zh.headline: 入境處破跨境偽證黑工集團 拘15人
zh.dek: 兩名主腦因安排偽造香港身份證及住宿予非法勞工，分別被判囚29及42個月。

en.headline: Privacy commissioner supports tighter land records access rules
en.dek: Ada Chung said misuse of land registry data for doxxing is worsening and journalists have no blanket exemption under the proposed arrangements.

zh.headline: 私隱專員支持收緊土地查冊安排
zh.dek: 鍾麗玲表示土地登記冊資料被用於起底的情況有惡化跡象，傳媒亦無全面豁免。

en.headline: Modified fishing boats begin passenger trips under leisure fishery scheme
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said two converted vessels started operating experience tours from Aberdeen on Thursday, allowing passengers to watch hauling and taste the catch.

zh.headline: 改裝漁船開展休閒漁業體驗團 市民可出海觀起網
zh.dek: 漁護署表示兩艘符合載客安全規格的改裝漁船周四起於香港仔營運體驗團，讓乘客近距離觀看起網並試食漁獲。

en.headline: Windy weekend ahead with mainly cloudy skies and occasional rain patches
en.dek: The Observatory said Saturday and Sunday will see east to northeast winds of force 5 to 6, occasionally stronger offshore, with temperatures between 25 and 28 degrees.

zh.headline: 周末風勢頗大 大致多雲間中有雨
zh.dek: 天文台表示周六日吹東至東北風5至6級，離岸及高地間中更強，氣溫介乎25至28度。

en.headline: New World removes Emperor Theatre relief over collapse risk, studies restoration
en.dek: The developer said the 8-metre Chan Mi Dong Zhuo artwork on the Grade 1 North Point building had structural problems and was removed with Buildings Department approval.

zh.headline: 新世界因倒塌風險移除皇都戲院浮雕 正研究修復
zh.dek: 發展商表示北角一級歷史建築正門8米高「蟬迷董卓」浮雕有結構問題，已獲屋宇署批准移除並妥善存放。

en.headline: Police arrest nine over guess-who phone scams targeting elderly, recover all funds
en.dek: West Kowloon officers dismantled a syndicate in an operation from mid-October to 4 November, seizing phones after six victims aged 73 to 86 lost about HK$325,000.

zh.headline: 警方破「猜猜我是誰」電騙集團 拘9人起回全數逾32萬元
zh.dek: 西九龍總區10月中至11月4日行動，針對6名73至86歲長者，損失約32.5萬元已全數追回。

en.headline: Law firm reportedly to move from Central to Hysan Lee Garden Eight
en.dek: Market sources say Woo Kwan Lee & Lo has reserved about 39,000 square feet in the Causeway Bay development after more than 50 years in Jardine House.

zh.headline: 有消息指律師行將由中環遷往希慎利園八期
zh.dek: 市場消息稱胡關李羅律師行預留約3.9萬平方英尺，結束在怡和大廈超過50年的租用。

en.headline: Lantau Yacht Club Boat Show opens today as public part of Festival of Connoisseurs
en.dek: The free-admission event at Discovery Bay runs until 8 November with more than 30 yachts on display and marine technology booths, linked to the AsiaWorld-Expo luxury exhibition.

zh.headline: 大嶼山遊艇會船展今日開幕 屬鑑賞家盛典公開部分
zh.dek: 愉景灣活動至8日免費入場（需預先登記），展出逾30艘遊艇及海事科技，並與亞洲國際博覽館奢華展覽相連。

en.headline: Water Supplies Department says Shau Kei Wan black particles are asphalt and meet standards
en.dek: The department said samples from affected areas contained trace asphalt from pipe linings raised during post-repair flushing, but all met Hong Kong drinking water standards and supply has cleared.

zh.headline: 水務署指筲箕灣食水黑點為瀝青 化驗符合標準
zh.dek: 署方表示受影響地區樣本含維修後沖洗揚起的微量瀝青，但全部符合香港食水標準，供水已回復清澈。

en.headline: Intangible Cultural Heritage Mart opens this weekend at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free three-day event at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza A and B features workshops, lion dance, martial arts and traditional music from 6 to 8 November.

zh.headline: 非物質文化遺產市集周末在文化中心舉行
zh.dek: 一連三日免費活動於香港文化中心露天廣場A及B區舉行，設有工作坊、舞獅、武術及傳統音樂表演。

en.headline: 61-year-old worker dies after being struck by vehicle at Sha Tin site
en.dek: The Labour Department is investigating after a female worker was run over by a grab lorry while washing vehicle tyres at a construction site entrance near Pok Hong Estate on Thursday.

zh.headline: 沙田工地女工被抓斗貨車輾斃 勞工處展開調查
zh.dek: 一名61歲女工周四上午在沙田路近博康邨地盤出入口沖洗車胎時，被抓斗貨車輾過身亡，勞工處已發出暫時停工通知書。

en.headline: Police to introduce AI facial recognition on SmartView CCTV this month
en.dek: The force said the feature, tested on missing elderly cases and a robbery, will expand coverage toward 60,000 cameras by 2028, with several malls agreeing to link systems.

zh.headline: 警方銳眼計劃本月加入人工智能人臉識別
zh.dek: 行動部高級警司梁銘亮表示，系統已測試協助尋回失智長者及偵破行劫案，並有多個商場同意今年內接入，目標2028年約六萬支鏡頭。

en.headline: M+ at Night returns Friday with RubberBand and live performances
en.dek: The museum’s evening programme on 6 November features Cantopop group RubberBand, indie band Goodnight Lillie and the Recycled Orchestra of Cateura until midnight.

zh.headline: M+夜不同周五回歸 RubberBand等樂隊演出
zh.dek: 西九文化區M+周五晚上舉行夜不同活動，至午夜有RubberBand、Goodnight Lillie及Recycled Orchestra of Cateura演出。

en.headline: National Security Department arrests 34-year-old man over seditious book imports
en.dek: Police detained a local company director in Mong Kok on Thursday on suspicion of importing publications with seditious intention under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance.

zh.headline: 國安處旺角拘捕34歲男子 涉輸入煽動書籍
zh.dek: 警方周四在旺角拘捕一名本地公司董事，涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》輸入具煽動意圖的刊物。

en.headline: Domestic helper arrested after five-month-old baby found unconscious in Yuen Long
en.dek: Police detained a domestic helper on suspicion of child abuse after a five-month-old girl was found unconscious at a village house in Ha San Wai on Thursday evening.

zh.headline: 元朗五個月大女嬰昏迷送院 外傭涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 周四晚上元朗下新圍村一名五個月大女嬰被發現昏迷，警方以涉嫌虐兒拘捕一名外傭。

en.headline: Kwun Tong grandmother jailed 20 days for slapping five-year-old
en.dek: Leung Lai-ha, 68, admitted assaulting a girl at APM mall after a basketball dispute involving her grandson and was sentenced by the magistrate on Thursday.

zh.headline: 觀塘APM商場婆婆摑五歲女童判監20日
zh.dek: 68歲梁麗霞承認在孫兒與女童爭籃球後襲擊對方，周四被裁判官判監20日兼罰款3000元。

en.headline: Director and firm plead guilty in HK$52.9m bottled water contract fraud
en.dek: Lui Tsz-chung and Xin Ding Xin Trade admitted submitting altered certificates to win a government contract supplying drinking water to civil servants.

zh.headline: 內地公司及董事承認政府瓶裝水合約詐騙 涉5290萬元
zh.dek: 雷子聰及鑫鼎鑫商貿承認向政府物流署提交經改動證書，以取得向公務員供應飲用水的合約。

en.headline: Overall crime rises 2.1 percent in first three quarters, driven by fraud
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said 68,015 cases were recorded from January to September, with fraud accounting for nearly half at 34,679 cases.

zh.headline: 首三季罪案升2.1% 詐騙案帶動整體上升
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，今年1月至9月錄得68015宗罪案，詐騙案佔近一半，共34679宗。

en.headline: Department of Justice launches HK$20,000 lawtech subscription scheme
en.dek: Small law firms and newly qualified barristers can claim up to HK$20,000 for one-year subscriptions to designated legal technology services until 29 January.

zh.headline: 律政司推出兩萬元法律科技訂購資助計劃
zh.dek: 中小型律師事務所及年資較淺大律師可獲最多兩萬元資助，訂購一年指定法律科技服務，申請期至明年1月29日。

en.headline: Customs raids seven illicit cigarette retail points, arrests 10
en.dek: Officers posing as customers seized about 128,000 sticks worth HK$580,000 during a three-day territory-wide operation targeting newsstands and stalls.

zh.headline: 海關搗破七個私煙零售點 拘捕十人
zh.dek: 關員喬裝顧客三日全港行動，檢獲約12.8萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，市值約58萬元。

en.headline: AFCD launches dual-use fishing boat pilot for leisure tours
en.dek: Two modified vessels will offer guided trips from Aberdeen where visitors can watch net hauling and learn about local fish species.

zh.headline: 漁護署推「漁＋樂」漁船計劃 示範船載客出海
zh.dek: 兩艘改裝漁船將於香港仔水域提供導賞團，讓市民近距離觀看起網及認識本地魚種。

en.headline: Cathay Pacific to pay one-month discretionary bonus to eligible Hong Kong staff
en.dek: Eligible Hong Kong-based employees will receive the 2026 bonus equivalent to one month of qualifying pay on 7 January, the airline said in an internal message.

zh.headline: 國泰向香港合資格員工發放一個月酌情花紅
zh.dek: 航空公司在內部訊息中表示，常駐香港的合資格員工將於明年1月7日獲發相當於一個月合資格薪酬的2026年度酌情花紅。

en.headline: CHP infection control head issued warning over driving conviction
en.dek: The Medical Council ordered a warning letter for Dr Edmond Ma Siu-keung after he failed to report a 2024 dangerous-driving conviction within 28 days.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心感染控制主管因危駕定罪被醫委會發警告信
zh.dek: 馬紹強醫生因未在28日內向醫委會申報2024年危險駕駛定罪，周四紀律研訊後被下令發出警告信。

en.headline: Federated Hermes opens Hong Kong office in Central
en.dek: The US asset manager, which manages US$884 billion, has set up in the Nexxus Building after two years of preparation to deepen Asia-Pacific ties.

zh.headline: Federated Hermes在中環開設香港辦公室
zh.dek: 這家管理8840億美元資產的美國資產管理公司經過兩年籌備後，在Nexxus大廈設立辦事處，加強亞太聯繫。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 3.67 percent higher at 24796.98
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks rose nearly 880 points on Thursday, with the Hang Seng Tech Index gaining 5.55 percent amid broad strength in technology shares.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市升3.67%報24796.98點
zh.dek: 港股周四上升近880點，恒生科技指數升5.55%，科網股普遍造好。

en.headline: Man arrested after Yuen Long rooftop standoff following alleged assault
en.dek: Police detained a 39-year-old man on suspicion of wounding after he was persuaded from a rooftop on Kik Yeung Road, where a woman had been injured earlier.

zh.headline: 元朗男子危坐天台後被捕 涉傷人
zh.dek: 警方在擊壤路勸服一名39歲男子離開天台後，以涉嫌傷人拘捕他；一名50歲女子較早時頸手受傷送院。

en.headline: Female road worker killed by dump truck in Sha Tin
en.dek: A woman died after a dump truck struck and ran over her at a road-widening site on Sha Tin Road near Pok Hong Estate on Thursday morning. Police are investigating.

zh.headline: 沙田路修路女工遭泥頭車輾斃
zh.dek: 周四早上沙田路近博康邨路面擴闊工地，一名女工遭泥頭車撞倒輾過後當場死亡，警方正調查。

en.headline: Education Bureau says TSA student performance remains steady
en.dek: Primary 3 and Secondary 3 results in Chinese, English and Mathematics were generally stable this year and aligned with previous assessments, the bureau said after receiving the HKEAA report.

zh.headline: 教育局：系統評估學生中英數表現保持平穩
zh.dek: 考評局提交的2026年全港性系統評估報告顯示，小三及中三學生在中、英、數科表現大致平穩，與上次結果相若。

en.headline: High Court sentences Joshua Wong to 10 years for foreign collusion
en.dek: The 30-year-old activist, already serving a term for subversion, received the concurrent sentence after pleading guilty to conspiring with Nathan Law and others to lobby for sanctions.

zh.headline: 高等法院判黃之鋒串謀勾結外國勢力罪名成立 判監10年
zh.dek: 30歲的黃之鋒早前承認控罪，新刑期與現正服刑的顛覆罪刑期同期執行，他原定明年1月刑滿。

en.headline: HAVF home audio-visual festival opens tomorrow at Kowloon Tong InnoCentre
en.dek: The free two-day event features LG, Sony and other brands demonstrating televisions, soundbars and home cinema systems from 6 to 7 November.

zh.headline: HAVF視聽娛樂祭明起於九龍塘創新中心舉行
zh.dek: 為期兩日的免費活動將於11月6日至7日舉行，現場有LG、Sony等品牌示範電視、Soundbar及家庭影院系統。

en.headline: Man arrested after alleged tile assault in Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 53-year-old man was detained on suspicion of wounding after police said he used a tile to strike a 48-year-old man late Wednesday night in Sheung Shui.

zh.headline: 上水醉漢涉用瓷磚襲擊途人被捕
zh.dek: 一名53歲男子涉嫌傷人被捕，警方指他周三深夜在上水以瓷磚襲擊一名48歲男子，傷者面嘴受傷送院。

en.headline: VTC opens applications for 2027/28 programmes with expanded places
en.dek: The Vocational Training Council begins accepting applications today for about 140 full-time programmes, increasing overall study places by more than 10 percent to over 14,000.

zh.headline: 職業訓練局今日起接受2027/28學年課程申請 學額增逾一成
zh.dek: 職訓局今日起接受約140項全日制課程報名，整體學額增加超過一成至逾14,000個，方便中六學生規劃升學。

en.headline: Hong Kong Optical Fair continues with seminars and smart eyewear displays
en.dek: The three-day trade event at HKCEC features more than 600 exhibitors from 14 countries, with programmes on functional eyewear running today.

zh.headline: 香港國際眼鏡展續展 智能眼鏡及功能鏡片成焦點
zh.dek: 為期三日的商貿展在會展舉行，逾600間來自14個國家及地區的參展商參與，今日有功能眼鏡研討環節。

en.headline: Driver arrested after FEHD contractor truck hits pedestrian in North Point
en.dek: A 45-year-old man was detained on suspicion of dangerous driving causing serious injury after his medium goods vehicle struck a 60-year-old woman on King's Road late Wednesday.

zh.headline: 北角食環署外判貨車撞途人 45歲司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 一名45歲男子涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕，其駕駛的中型貨車周三深夜在英皇道撞倒一名60歲女途人。

en.headline: HKU Faculty of Arts launches inaugural Being Human Festival
en.dek: The free public programme runs until 15 November with workshops, performances and talks under the theme Crossroads at venues including Tai Hang.

zh.headline: 港大文學院首辦「人文藝術節」今日起至15日
zh.dek: 主題「十字路口」的免費公眾活動包括工作坊、表演及對談，場地涵蓋大坑等地。

en.headline: HKTDC Wine and Spirits Fair opens today at HKCEC with over 620 exhibitors
en.dek: The 18th edition runs until Saturday, with a public tasting zone open on the final day for visitors aged 18 and above.

zh.headline: 香港國際美酒展今日在會展開幕 逾620間參展商參與
zh.dek: 第18屆展覽至周六結束，最後一天設公眾品酒區，18歲或以上人士可入場。
